home.title: Consignment portability without friction
home.subtitle: The consent, the discount agenda and the portability in one place, with the audit trail of every step.
home.systemStateBody: The visual shell is ready. Authorization, agenda, operations and audit arrive in the following slices, each with its contract and its evidence.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The requested address does not match any route of ConsigPort.

authorization.title: Authorize the agreement
authorization.description: The opt-in registers the beneficiary consent and unlocks the discount agenda.
authorization.required: Fill in the beneficiary and the agreement.

agenda.title: Discount agenda
agenda.description: Eligible installments of the authorized agreement.
agenda.missingBeneficiary: Enter the beneficiary to see the agenda.
agenda.empty: No eligible installment in the agenda.

portability.title: Request portability
portability.description: Enter the receiving account and send the operation.
portability.noSelection: No installment selected. Choose the installments in the agenda.

operations.title: Operation status
operations.description: Follow the operation until its terminal state.
operations.missingOperation: Tell us which operation to follow.
operations.unavailable: The operation could not be queried.

audit.title: Event trail
audit.description: Every transition of the operation, in the order it happened.
audit.empty: The operation has no events yet.

errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: The submitted data did not pass validation.
errors.AUTHORIZATION_NOT_FOUND: This beneficiary has no consent registered.
errors.BENEFICIARY_NOT_FOUND: The Central does not know this beneficiary.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: This operation was already sent with a different content.
errors.INSTALLMENT_NOT_ELIGIBLE: One of the installments is not eligible.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something broke on our side. Try again.
